column3: if · A Rocking Rock Chapter
I... just remembered I have something to do, so I'm leaving.
Huh? Hey, Manami?
Bye bye, Kyou-chan～
Ah, it's Bro!
The person standing behind me as I turn around is Manami's little brother, Rock.
What perfect timing.
Or maybe... the worst timing...?
Oh Rock, it's you.
What's with that "it's you"?
Exactly what it means.
What's up, Bro! You kinda seem down. Did something happen?
You should celebrate the end of school! Ah! That's right; how about kicking a can on the way home like we used to? Bro!
You sure are lively... This level of stupidity is rather praise-worthy.
F-For real? You make me blush... Hehe.
Stop it. I'm not really praising you. That's something Manami would say...
Ah, where is she, by the way? Didn't you come back together?
Nah, she said she has something to do and went somewhere else.
Oh, did she?
Surely... That discussion earlier may have came as a shock for her.
Rock.
'Sup, Bro?
I have an important task for you.
RRRReally!? Something interesting?!
As expected of middle schoolers. Duty, responsibility... as long as you use serious words, they'll eat it up and believe anything. But this is
the second time and he still doesn't realize. Is he stupid or what?
At any rate, I'll play my cards right.
Today, when you get home, will you check on Manami's condition?
Check her condition?
That's right. There's something I'm worried about... When she is out of my sight, you're the only one I can rely on. Can you do it?
Count on me, Bro! After all, Bro's going to become my real bro real soon!
As I said, it's more complex than that. Anyway, I'm counting on you!
Roger!
Then, the next day-
I waited for Rock on the way home after school.
Manami skipped school...
So something bad did happen...?
Bro!
Hey, Rock, how did it go?
Ah, crap, yesterday I watched that music TV show I like, "Okyou de DIVE", so I completely forgot.
Oh, I see, it can't be helped then. Rock, come here for a second.
Hm? What for?
After calmly putting my backpack on the ground, I poised my palm in front of that buzz-cut's eyes.
I then grabbed his forehead and gripped it.
It hurts, Bro! It hurts! It hurts, ouch!
Ah, sorry. I couldn't control my strength with such a grab-able head.
That's so mean, Bro!
You always had such a finely shaped head!
Even if you praise me while gripping my head, I won't be happy!
Convinced by Rock's watery eyes, I let go of his head.
As I did, Rock painfully rubbed his head and stared at me.
I-It was a joke, Bro. The truth is, I did check on Big Sis's condition.
Oh. You should have said so sooner.
But you see...
Hm? What's wrong? Is it something hard to say?
W-Well, you could say that...
It's fine. Just tell me straight.
It appears that Big Sis is somehow going abroad...
What? Are you guys going to close up shop and open up a new one in some foreign country?
No, we don't have any plans for that. Rather, there's no way we could.
Don't tell me jokes then!
It hurts! It hurts, Bro! Please stop with the headlocks!
Ahah, sorry. I did it without thinking.
That wasn't a joke!
...Seriously?
Before I noticed, I released my firm grip on Rock's buzz cut head and considered what he said.
I heard Mom and Dad talk about it yesterday. Bro, did something happen between you and Big Sis?
No, nothing special...
I see. Big Sis seemed fine. Maybe she doesn't mind long-distance relationships?
S-She was fine? She wasn't depressed?
Yeah, she somehow seemed like she made up her mind.
Made up her mind...?
What the hell is going on?
Then the next day, Manami did not come to school for the closing ceremony.
The homeroom teacher was told that it was "Family Matters."
Manami didn't answer any of my phone calls... When I was finally able to meet her, we were nearing the middle of the summer holidays.
You...?!  Manami...?
Yes. It's been a while, Kyou-chan.
I mean, this style... How to put it...
What about it?
Haven't you become insanely cute?!
Yes, the Manami I haven't seen for a while had totally changed her appearance to that of an idol.
However, it's not like she did anything artificial like plastic surgery... She had a naturally refined face as if she had used beauty treatments.
But above all, her body silhouette visibly changed. Her waistline is now perfect.
Compared to before, her chest is now more prominent.
Frankly speaking, she's a beauty.
Because of what Kyou-chan told me, I had a revelation.
The current "me" is wrong. But going back to the "previous" me seemed impossible so... I boldly decided to aim for my childhood dream!
A dream?! Did you have such a thing?
Yes! You didn't know? My dream was to become an idol that sings and dance on TV, and become the star of every household's living room!
Those expressions... "sing and dance", "household"... they stink of old lady, so it really IS Manami?!
...This isn't the right time to say that. S-So then... What about the dating stuff...
Yes... Let's end that already?
Whaaat?! I got rejected by Manami?!
I'm quitting school and aiming for my dream, so I came to say farewell.
Thank you, Kyou-chan. Thanks to you, I was able to find my own path. Watch out for me in the future!
Y-Yeah...
Broo!
Rock... Y-You too?!
This Rock has the look of a heavy metal band's vocalist; quite frankly, he's insanely cool.
Ah, for now, we're planning to make our debut as a duo. Rock is playing the shamisen, I'm singing.
Whaaaaat?!
Bastard! Rock! You knew about this!
Ah, the hair is a sham though; I plan to make it even more awesome when my real hair grows!
I didn't ask about that!!
Ouchouchouchouch!!  Sorry Bro, I give up! My joints don't bend that way, Bro!
Start talking!
W-Well, Big Sis said that she had a revelation with your advice, so she's aiming for her dream, and I am also aiming for that dream with her.
Which is why we used the first half of this summer's holiday to prepare ourselves.
We've already signed a contract with Ayase-chan's agency; we're going to make our debut next month.
You two...
Kyou-chan/Bro, thanks for everything!
T-The Manami I know... can't be this rocking...
